product_summary: Coconut-shell activated carbon only. Per activcarb.com/products: granular activated carbon in 15 mesh cuts (1x6 to 35x80 USS, e.g. 4x8, 8x30, 12x40, 20x50) and powdered activated carbon (80x200, 80x325, -200, -325 USS, plus fine mesh -400/-500 USS). Per activcarb.com/applications: acid-washed / water-washed (low-ash, food grade, pH-adjusted) carbon, dedusted material, and impregnated carbon for cigarette filters. Applications named: air & gas treatment (VOC removal), gold recovery, water/waste-water treatment, cigarette filters, breweries/distilleries. Plant: rotary-kiln steam activation, stated capacity 3600 MT/yr of granular + powdered AC; site at Chinnaputhur, Dharapuram Taluk, Tiruppur Dist., Tamil Nadu; nearest port Tuticorin.
comment: HS 380210 ('activated carbon') matches the declared code exactly at HS-6 — the entire published range (granular, powdered, acid-washed, impregnated, fine-mesh coconut-shell AC) falls under 380210. No HS correction needed. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a loose fit: the company is a chemicals/adsorbents maker, not an oil & gas supplier; air/gas treatment is only an end-use application, not an upstream O&G role. Trader signs: none found — the site describes own manufacturing (activation hall, rotary kiln, in-house sizing/sieving, stated 3600 MT/yr capacity), so manufacturer is the reasonable role hint, though the site is the only evidence and no independent plant/customs corroboration was checked here (out of scope for this role). Product lines possibly missing from a narrow declaration: acid-washed/food-grade and impregnated (cigarette-filter) carbon are value-added variants that may be declared under different national tariff lines or as separate items; also note the company sells by mesh size, so a single 380210 line covers all of it. All product claims are from the company's own website only — status: заявлено, не подтверждено (no customs line reviewed in this task). No PAN, CIN, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope; not public here — null.
